name: brownfield
description: Updates to existing codebases. Emphasizes existing patterns, migration strategies, and backward compatibility.

workflowEmphasis: Understand and respect existing code patterns
Consider migration paths for breaking changes
Document integration points with existing code
guidance.documentationFocus: Integration with existing systems, migration plans, and compatibility considerations
keyConsiderations: What existing patterns should be followed?
Are there deprecated APIs or patterns to avoid?
How will this change affect existing functionality?
What migration strategy is needed for existing data or users?
Are there integration tests covering affected areas?
